title: Warranty Coverage Transfer Desk Guidance: Passing Coverage to a Buyer of the Home
content:
When the registered owner sells the home, Warranty Coverage may pass to the buyer if the plan allows it.

## Rule in force

1. A registration can be transferred only when its plan is transferable and it was preceded by fewer transfers than the plan allows.
2. The seller requests the transfer, giving the buyer's name and email and the home sale closing date from the closing documents.
3. A transfer is accepted only when it is requested no later than the transfer window after the home sale closing date. Calendar days are counted from the day after the home sale closing date, and a request on the last day of the window is accepted.
4. On completion the seller's registration becomes transferred and the buyer, under the buyer's own customer profile (opened from the buyer's name and email when the buyer has none), receives a new registration under the same plan with the original coverage start date, one more prior transfer, and every product term capped at the plan's transferred product term and the labor and workmanship terms capped at the plan's transferred labor term, all counted from the original coverage start date.
5. A request that misses the window or exceeds the transfer limit is not accepted, and a pending transfer the seller withdraws returns the registration to active with its fee reversed.

Whether a plan is transferable, its transfer limit, window, fee and later-owner caps are the figures of the plan's transfer schedule.

## Withdrawn — no longer in force

> The plan's transfer fee is charged to the seller on the request date.

This sentence is **no longer in force**; the current basis for the transfer fee replaces it. The plan's transfer fee itself remains a valid figure of the transfer schedule.

## Evidence

| Condition | Evidence | Authority |
|---|---|---|
| Plan transferable and transfer limit not reached | the registration's plan and the count of transfers that preceded it | system record |
| Requested within the window | the home sale closing date on the transfer request, given by the seller from the closing documents, and the request date | the transfer request record |

## Window — boundary (hypothetical 60-day window)

Home sale closing date 10 June. Day one is 11 June; day sixty is 9 August.
- Requested 9 August: accepted (last day of the window).
- Requested 10 August: not accepted.

## Transfer limit — cases

| Transfers allowed by the plan | Transfers that preceded the registration | Can be transferred |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | 0 | yes |
| 1 | 1 | no |
| 2 | 1 | yes |
| 0 (plan not transferable) | 0 | no |

superseded_clauses: The plan's transfer fee is charged to the seller on the request date.
